definition: Arabic packs what English spreads across words into single tokens: وسيكتبونها ("and they will write it") is one orthographic word.
details: Arabic packs what English spreads across words into single tokens: وسيكتبونها ("and they will write it") is one orthographic word. Consequences everywhere: higher tokenizer fertility, sparser word statistics, harder exact-match retrieval, and error metrics that need character-level views.
